catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds an oscilloscope autoset: it is a one-shot instrument command with no input and only an applied flag, not a setpoint, a measurement or a configuration patch. cap.device.configure.v1 is the write class and cannot express an input-less one-shot command. The package uses this extension until a generic instrument one-shot class exists.

PASSED on the fake backend only: python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/aakafosfor__hameg_hm1507 --backend fake exited 0 on 2026-10-30; G1 to G9 passed with no findings or warnings; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by is a model, reviewed_by is null); no human reviewed or tested it, no hardware was attached or run, and no hardware run is claimed. It is R1, so the loader review gate for R2/R3 does not apply and no such protection is claimed.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's family-config/SerialDriver shape was not usable. The upstream class does not send text command lines; it assembles byte commands from parts: 'TB'+base+'='+chr(settings) (HAMEG_HM1507.py:93-100) and 'CH'+channel+'='+chr(settings) (HAMEG_HM1507.py:105-114), with settings a bit field. No text token of those lines exists in the clone, so a command table would either fail G7 or change the wire syntax. The package is therefore a direct Driver over HAMEG_HM1507:HAMEG_HM1507 with native.py connecting the upstream class to a required serial port. The fake implements only the upstream public methods (connect, disconnect, autoset, timeBase, channel); G7 passes.

WHAT IS COVERED: one object write for a time base (base A/B, single sweep, time/div from the 29 upstream values) and one object write for a channel (channel 1/2, invert, DC/AC, volts/div from the 14 upstream values), each sending exactly one upstream call; the autoset extension sends AUTOSET; the e-stop calls the upstream disconnect, which sends rm0 and closes the port (HAMEG_HM1507.py:70-75). Limits are the upstream allowed sets and cite the lines of the lists and selectors; there are no operator_required bounds, so no site-limits.example.json is shipped. The resource state reports the values this driver last wrote.

NOT COVERED: the oscilloscope trace and every measurement read. The upstream class has no read, query or acquisition method at all; its only readline is commented out (HAMEG_HM1507.py:77-85). No waveform array is transferred because the clone exposes no command that returns one; a front-panel change is not visible. This is a remote-control surface, not a scope acquisition driver.

MOCK PATH: the card prefers a transcript, but no recording, upstream simulator or upstream test exists (the clone has one commit and three Python files). The package fake is a stateful in-memory stand-in for HAMEG_HM1507 with the same protocol arithmetic and the same public methods; its command list and connection flag are test data, not facts. No hardware, network, pip install or upstream import was used by the gate or the fake.

LICENCE: the card records license_spdx NOASSERTION and license_class unknown; the clone has no LICENSE file and no README or manual. No licence conclusion was made and no vendor documentation was cited. The clone remained untouched (git status clean). The reference files were regenerated after the final driver change; check-report.json is the gate's own report and is not hand-edited.
